ahmed.name: Ahmed K.
ahmed.body: Finally managed to get the kids to bed by 8 PM tonight! Small wins feel like big victories. Any tips for keeping a consistent routine during weekends? 🌙

sarah.name: Sarah M.
sarah.body: Organized a small weekend reading circle for the neighborhood kids. It's so heartening to see them engage with books! 📚✨

anon.name: Anonymous Parent
anon.body: Does anyone have recommendations for pediatricians in the downtown area who are great with toddlers having dental anxiety?

layla.name: Layla R.
layla.body: School readiness tip: we practiced short circle time at home with a visual timer before kindergarten — a huge help for transitions.

omar.name: Omar H.
omar.body: For speech delay: narrating everyday activities (bath, snack) gave us more words than flashcards alone. Praise for any attempt worked best.
